workflows.name: Rich blog announcement
workflows.description: HMAC-signed endpoint: HTML caption with escaping, photo when the post has a usable image, text message otherwise. Sends to TELEGRAM_CHANNEL_ID.

config.caption: {{trigger.body.title | default:"New post" | decode_entities | truncate:200 | escape_html}} {{trigger.body.excerpt | strip_html | truncate:600 | escape_html}} ✍️ {{trigger.body.author.name | default:"Editorial team" | escape_html}} Read more

config.text: {{trigger.body.title | default:"New post" | decode_entities | truncate:200 | escape_html}} {{trigger.body.excerpt | strip_html | truncate:1500 | escape_html}} Read more
